subject: Dedicated capacity: term options, ramp schedule, and desired start dates
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zenithhealth.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@zenithhealth.com
Date: 2026-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity inquiry — term lengths / start dates

Hi Neha,

Quick note from procurement as we scope Dedicated: thanks for the product overview last week. A few items we need to validate on your side before we move to an SOW:

- We are evaluating 12/24/36 month commit options — would like per-month and effective unit pricing for each term (including any step-downs at quarter boundaries).
- Can you confirm earliest capacity start dates for a north-america pool sized for ~40 p100-equivalent vCPUs / ~10k tokens/sec steady throughput (60/40 read/write workload)?
- We need a recommended ramp schedule (month-by-month allocation) you’ve done for similar customers — Zenity Health prefers a soft start over 90 days, then a hard commit.
- Throughput SLA expectations / remediation credits for missed throughput guarantees.

Can you send an initial options matrix and a proposed ramp plan? We’re aiming to present internally next Thurs (3/25).

Appreciate it —
Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Procurement | Zenith Health
laura.chen@zenithhealth.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-22T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity inquiry — term lengths / start dates

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list.

We can put together a concise matrix (12/24/36) with: list price, committed discount, example ramp profiles, and a throughput SLO with remediation bands. FYI I’ll include two ramp options: conservative 90-day soft-start and an accelerated 45-day ramp.

Couple of clarifying Qs so we size the pool correctly:
- The ~40 p100-equivalent number — is that your sustained peak or the average target? If peak, we’ll recommend a larger buffer for burst capacity.
- Any region constraints besides NA? (e.g., which AZ/region you prefer)

I’ll circulate a short deck + spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow (3/23) so you have time for the 3/25 internal.

Next steps: I’ll draft two term proposals (12/24/36) plus a proposed calendar with start-date windows.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachment: zenith_pricing_questions.pdf (your original question list)
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zenithhealth.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-23T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity inquiry — term lengths / start dates

Neha — quick answers:
- 40 p100-equivalent is our steady-state target (we have daily patterns but that is the figure we want covered without throttling).
- Region: us-west preferred (primary AZs ok).
- On SLA: a remediation credit is fine; what typically gets negotiated is a % credit per hour below the guaranteed throughput tier and an upper bound that caps our exposure.

We’ll review your materials tomorrow. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Laura

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-23T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity inquiry — term lengths / start dates

Team — forwarding Zenith’s clarifications. They want 40 p100-equivalent sustained in us-west with a soft 90-day ramp preferred. Deadline: internal review 3/25.

Drafted two offers in the attached pricing deck (redwood_dedicated_pricing_deck_v3.pdf):
Option A (12 mo): 10% discount off list, 2-week provisioning window, limited burst pool (on-demand credits)
Option B (24 mo): 20% discount, guaranteed start window (we commit capacity by a hard date), staged billing for months 1–3 at 50% to support soft start
Option C (36 mo): 26% discount, prioritized capacity placement, 60-day provisioning SLA, additional 6% renewal credit after year 1

I’ve included a proposed ramp profile: month 1 = 25% capacity, month 2 = 60%, month 3 onward = 100% (90-day soft ramp), and an accelerated: month 1 = 40%, month 2 = 80%, month 3 = 100% (45-day essentially).

Two asks before I send to Zen:
1) Approve a negotiable discount floor for 24mo: can we go to 22% for committed deal (deal_id RW-23451) if they accept staged billing and a firm start date?
2) SLA / remediation wording: we usually commit to 99.5% throughput availability per month; remediation is pro rata credit up to 10% of that month's invoice. OK to offer a 12-month ramp-exception clause for their soft start?

Rishi — need sign-off on the discount stretch. Karthik — please confirm we can commit to a 99.5% throughput SLO for the described pool and the proposed remediation cap.

Thanks —
Neha

Attachment: redwood_dedicated_pricing_deck_v3.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-24T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity inquiry — term lengths / start dates

Neha — thanks for the clear options. Approve the 22% floor on 24mo if they: (a) sign a firm start date (we commit capacity by that date), and (b) accept staged billing for first 3 months at 50/75/100%. Good to include the accelerated ramp as a seller-favored alternative.

On SLA: Karthik, if we put 99.5% throughput SLO with a 10% max monthly credit, ensure the runbook and autoscaling knobs are documented in the SOW. If we can provide the SLO backed by an ops escalation path and a 48-hour remediation pilot (runbook execution), we’re comfortable.

Go for it Neha — get their confirmation on start windows and sign-off on staged billing.

Rishi
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zenithhealth.com>, procure@zenithhealth.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-26T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity inquiry — term lengths / start dates

Hi Laura — thanks for the quick feedback and for confirming region + sizing. Based on internal approvals, here’s our recommended commercial path and ask: 

Summary (proposal):
- Term: 24 months (recommended)
- Effective discount: 22% off list for committed Dedicated pool sized for 40 p100-equivalent (us-west)
- Start window: firm capacity provision by 2026-05-15; we’ll provision a soft-capacity overlay for testing the week prior (5/8–5/14).
- Ramp (recommended): month 1 = 30% (validation/test), month 2 = 65%, month 3 onward = 100% (90-day soft ramp). Accelerated ramp available on request (45-day profile).
- Billing: staged billing months 1–3 = 50% / 75% / 100% of committed monthly fee (supports their soft-start economics).
- SLA: 99.5% throughput availability per calendar month; remediation: pro rata credit up to 10% of monthly invoice (detailed SOW will include runbook & ops escalation path).

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_pricing_deck_v3.pdf (detailed pricing and example calendar), zenith_pricing_questions.pdf (your question set annotated).

If this works, requested next steps:
1) Confirm term (24 mo) and the firm start date 2026-05-15 by reply — we’ll lock the capacity window.
2) I’ll send an SOW draft and a DocuSign link once you confirm.
3) If procurement needs a faster ramp or different staged-billing terms, flag which month profile you prefer and we’ll circulate a revised pricing line.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
